Hi Marissa,

We are starting the vendor security review for Redwood as part of our procurement intake. Our security and procurement teams have a consolidated ask:

1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed) + SOC2 cover letter.
2) Completed SIG questionnaire or CAIQ answers mapped to SIG controls.
3) Current subprocessor registry (vendor list with purpose, data access, residency).
4) KMS ownership / key custody matrix for any third-party key stores.
5) Any recent penetration test summary & remediation status.

Can you share a downloadable bundle or point us to a Drive folder? We would like an initial package within 7 business days to keep our procurement timeline. If some items need legal review (NDAs/redactions), let us know.

Thanks,

- Pen test: we have a summary (passed, two medium findings remediated Q2 2026). Ben will attach the one-page summary and issue tracker IDs.
